newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Akzo Nobel to raise carbon fibre capacity.
newsitem.headline: Akzo Nobel to raise carbon fibre capacity.

text.p: Chemical group Akzo Nobel NV said on Wednesday it would increase production capacity at its U.S.-based Fortafil Fibers carbon fibre plant by 64 percent to 3,500 tonnes per year.
"The company completed an expansion in 1996, but demand for Fortafil products continues to grow rapidly and has remained ahead of capacity," the Dutch group said.
The new production capacity is scheduled to be operational before the end of 1998. The project would include provisions to allow for further rapid expansion.
"All segments of the carbon fibre industry have been growing rapidly in recent months, and the industry appears to be set for a period of sustained growth," Akzo Nobel added.
